CustomField.description: Boolean formula that returns TRUE when this commitment's ExpectedTotalCmtAmount falls in the Entry band — at or above Entry.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c but below Mid.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c. The three commitment checkboxes (Entry / Mid / Major) are mutually exclusive — at most one is TRUE for any commitment. GiftCommitment has no CurrentAmount field, so ExpectedTotalCmtAmount (total pledged value) is used as the amount basis. Lifetime thresholds are used because a commitment represents a total pledge, not a single transaction. Thresholds are configured via Setup → Custom Metadata Types → FQS Donor Tier or the FQS Setup screen flow. Changing threshold values recalculates this field across all Gift Commitment records retroactively — no redeployment or batch job required.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated. The field is checked when this commitment's total expected amount qualifies for the Entry donor tier. Your administrator controls the threshold amount.
CustomField.label: Is Entry Commitment
